packageRules.description: atcr.io is a private registry and Renovate has no credentials for it (token request fails, lookups return no-result). Images there are bumped by hand. Add a read-only pull token in the Mend portal hostRules to track them instead
Immich Postgres: block major bumps, PG major upgrade needs a manual dump/restore (vector extensions)
helm CLI: stay on 3.x, helm 4 breaks helmfile v0.171.0 and the helm-diff plugin install
Group the ProxyAuthK8S chart with its CRD chart: the controller refuses to start against CRDs older than the app (checks spec.upstream_auth), and both publish the same versions
Corium: the OS image and cctl move together. ghcr also carries all-digit commit tags that would read as versions

customManagers.description: Corium node documents: Helm add-ons pinned under addons[] (no manager understands this shape)
